description: Set image-bound destination cards on an unpublished owned Facebook post. Supply exactly one card for each current image, 2–10 images. Pass carousel:null to clear. Does not publish.

carouselCards.description: Exactly one card per current image, 2–10

imageUrl.description: URL of one of the post's current images; binds this card to it

carouselLink.description: Optional "see more" link shown after the cards

carousel.description: One destination card per current image, in image order; null clears the carousel

postId.description: ID of the unpublished Facebook post (from list_posts)

name: set_facebook_carousel
title: Set Facebook Carousel
